text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Off we go to Tokyo Racecourse! Got
your lunches
packed with a carrot or two
for snack time?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then time to head off to watch the
Japanese
Derby, where the air's electric
and the view never
disappoints!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right behind you, Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised you just want me to
observe,
Trainer. I was sure you'd have
me run in it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just wondering, but, um... why'd didn't
you put
me in it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Kitasan Black was willing, of course I
would've
considered having her run the
Derby. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
2,400-meter long G1 races are unknown
territory for her, and the long
straightaways at Tokyo
Racecourse
really test runners' mettle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't imagine things going well. It
was safer to skip the race than to risk
having her suffer an
overwhelming
defeat and lose all confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for the race itself...
It goes exactly as
I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What speed! We haven't seen runners
sprinting this fast before! And now the
front of the pack is
being disrupted!
Breaking through the bunch is—

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Brusquement! Brusquement crosses the
finish line! No one was able to stop her!
And she's set a
Derby record, folks!
We've witnessed history!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A Derby record... Wow... If I had been
out there...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't have been able to do a
thing... There's no way I could've kept
up with that pace, no
matter how hard I
tried to tough it out...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was just coincidence or fate,
that
overwhelming victory leaves Kitasan
Black
speechless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We return to my office and recap
today's events.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... 2,400-meter races... Medium and
long-distance races are scary... The
second you
run out of stamina, it's game
over.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Do you think I can handle G1 races that
are
2,400 meters or longer, just like the
one today? I
really don't feel like I can...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No worries, Kitasan Black! There's
nothing to fret
about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O, who has been
listening to us talk the whole time,
inserts herself into the
conversation, full
of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You've got the aptitude for both
medium and
long races! There's no
mistaking it, so don't you
worry!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
How can you be so sure I'll be okay,
Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! How could I not be? Just
who do
you think your super special
coach is, hm?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It is I, Sakura Bakushin O! The Umamusume who has been victorious in three 1,200-meter races—aka 3,600 meters total! That's super long distance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As far as I know, Sakura Bakushin O is a

specialized sprinter who has had many
great
showings in G1 sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, I've never heard anyone lump
three 1,200-meter sprints into one
long-distance 3,600-meter race... That's
just not sound
reasoning.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If Bakushin O says I'll be okay, then I
just might
be okay! Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gently try to stop Kitasan Black from
taking
Sakura Bakushin O's word at face
value, and take
a moment to think.
choice_data_list: No, surely I'm just imagining thin...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Distance aptitude is a hard factor to pin
down. The only way to get a solid
reading is to build up
experience in
actual races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I was sure she could
handle long
distances... But I can't say
for certain at this point.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I'm not really cut out for long
races...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Kikuka Sho might be even
tougher. That's 3,000 meters long. I'd
better keep my nose
to the grindstone
and train real hard!
